title: Hm
logline: The Legacy with its hood up in Gully's lot, Gully under it, from behind, twelve years of Tuesdays. The page can hear the one syllable and doesn't letter it.

panels.composition: A faded green station wagon with its hood up in a gravel lot, a heavy gray man bent under the hood from behind, a thin man in plaid leaning on the fender from behind, a small three-legged dog sitting between their boots.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a faded green station wagon with its hood up in a gravel lot, a heavy gray-haired man bent under the hood and a thin man in plaid leaning on the fender both seen from behind, a small three-legged dog sitting between their boots, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
